D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Terri Sewell leads by 48.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 121,134 votes; a one point swing is about 1,249 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +38.8 and D +57.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$3.8M cash against $116K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
